newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria bought additional 50,000 T of French wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria bought additional 50,000 T of French wheat.

text.p: Algeria has bought an additional 50,000 tonnes of French wheat, lifting its total purchases of French wheat under a Coface-guaranteed export credit to 125,000 tonnes, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
The wheat was priced at $178.75 per tonne, including freight and the cost of the Coface credit.
One cargo is for shipment between February 25 and March 10 and another is for shipment in the first half of March, traders said.
One exporter, however, said Algeria may choose cash payment for one of the additional wheat cargoes.
On Tuesday Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for shipment in February and March at $150 per tonne, fob.
Exporters said that adding freight and the cost of the Coface credit the purchase price of the initial 75,000 tonnes was $178.75 per tonne.
